compiled_state.title: [ticket-lib-api.sh]: ticket list --has-tag= unsupported by in-process path -> exits 1
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 349ec90f7e164fc44e7f937f0096a87ec9b2bd4e

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** Sub-Agent Blocker

#### Expected Behavior

`.claude/scripts/dso ticket list --has-tag=detected_by:tests` exits 0 and returns only bug-type tickets. This is SC-2 of epic a34c.

#### Actual Behavior

Exits 1: `Error: unknown option '--has-tag=detected_by:tests'`

The in-process `ticket_list()` in `plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-lib-api.sh` does not implement `--has-tag`. The legacy `ticket-list.sh` does (with auto-intersection to bug type for detected_by: tags), but the in-process path (default since ticket-lib-api.sh was introduced) does not.

comments.body: Fixed: ticket_list() in ticket-lib-api.sh now honors --has-tag with detected_by:* auto-intersection (commit cdf2e1fa2f). Re-running SC2 verification.
comments.author: Test
